phrases.text: God swears by time. The commentators differed over what the word means: some said it is an hour out of the hours of the day, and some said it is the evening. Tabari takes it as a name for time itself, the evening and the night and the day, without singling out one of them.
The son of Adam is in ruin and deficiency. Ali used to read it as: man is in loss, and he is in it until the end of time.

Those who have affirmed God and honoured Him in His oneness, and have done good deeds, and have kept what He imposed on them and left what He forbade them. Tabari notes that the word for man here is a plural, and the believers are excepted from it.
They have done righteous deeds and kept the obligatory ordinances and avoided what God forbade.

phrases.translation: and urge each other to the truth,
phrases.text: They have urged one another to act on what God sent down in His book. The commentators say the truth here means the book of God itself.

phrases.translation: and urge each other to perseverance
phrases.text: And they have urged one another to be patient in obeying God. The commentators say patience here means obedience to God.
